text: The Holy Melody That Summons the Light

You have decided to perform magic that uses music to restore
a blind girl's vision.

To activate it, you need instruments made from materials
that contain magic energy.
Collect them from Vykon Meadow!

You realize the instruments you made yourselves are not
enough to successfully perform the magic.

Explore the building called the "Music Hall" in Vykon Meadow
to obtain high-quality instruments!
The Vykon Music Hall is beautiful and elegant, but it is\nfull of dangerous monsters inside! Let's hurry to the top\nfloor to meet Glocke, the master of the building!

You can't relate to Glocke who is obsessed with music!
What's worse, he turns his instruments into weapons and
attacks you!

Defeat him with all your might to obtain the high-quality
instruments he has collected!
